mechanisms.label: Diesel / refining crisis
mechanisms.prompt_focus: Determine whether middle-distillate scarcity is tightening independently of crude. Distinguish crude shortage from refining bottleneck. Look specifically for falling/stable Brent while diesel or jet premiums remain elevated.

mechanisms.label: Product tanker ton-miles
mechanisms.prompt_focus: Test whether refined-product cargoes are travelling materially farther and whether effective fleet supply is tightening. Oil price alone is not evidence.

mechanisms.label: Crude tanker dislocation
mechanisms.prompt_focus: Measure whether crude sourcing shifts are increasing VLCC/Suezmax ton-mile demand and fleet utilization.

mechanisms.label: Atlantic barrels replace Gulf supply
mechanisms.prompt_focus: Determine whether buyers are structurally replacing Gulf barrels with Americas/Africa supply rather than making a one-off substitution.

mechanisms.label: Ceyhan / Kurdistan bypass
mechanisms.prompt_focus: Monitor sustained physical flow through Iraq-Turkey-Ceyhan. Announcements without barrels do not count.

mechanisms.label: LNG rerouting
mechanisms.prompt_focus: Test whether Gulf LNG disruption is creating a logistics shortage and rerouting demand toward Atlantic LNG.

mechanisms.label: Arsenal depletion / replenishment
mechanisms.prompt_focus: Find evidence that governments are changing procurement architecture or production targets because inventories are constrained. Ignore generic defense-spending headlines.

mechanisms.label: Rocket motor bottleneck
mechanisms.prompt_focus: Determine whether rocket propulsion is the binding constraint on higher missile output. Prefer supplier-level evidence over prime-contractor narrative.

mechanisms.label: Energetics / explosives shortage
mechanisms.prompt_focus: Investigate shortages in explosives, propellants, primers and energetic materials that can limit ammunition and missile output.

mechanisms.label: Strategic aluminium
mechanisms.prompt_focus: Determine whether military/electrical demand is colliding with limited high-purity domestic aluminium capacity.

mechanisms.label: Rare-earth magnets
mechanisms.prompt_focus: Locate the actual bottleneck: mining, separation, refining or magnet production. Connect it to defense, drones and robotics only where direct material exposure exists.

mechanisms.label: Cheap-drone scaling
mechanisms.prompt_focus: Require real procurement volumes and unit economics. Demonstrations and prototype announcements do not activate the mechanism.

mechanisms.label: Counter-UAS cost curve
mechanisms.prompt_focus: Test whether militaries are replacing expensive missile intercepts with cheaper EW, guns, lasers or interceptor drones.

mechanisms.label: Mine / underwater security
mechanisms.prompt_focus: Find sustained demand for autonomous mine countermeasures, sonar and underwater security. Require confirmed physical incidents or procurement.

mechanisms.label: AI time-to-power
mechanisms.prompt_focus: Determine whether electricity/interconnection rather than GPU supply is the binding constraint on AI infrastructure.

mechanisms.label: AI ghost demand
mechanisms.prompt_focus: Separate speculative interconnection requests from financed construction. A large fall in requested GW after deposit requirements is bearish for speculative developers but positive for suppliers with contracted backlog.

mechanisms.label: Behind-the-meter AI power
mechanisms.prompt_focus: Test whether data centers are bypassing utility queues with onsite generation and microgrids.

mechanisms.label: Robotics actuator scale
mechanisms.prompt_focus: Do not activate on demos. Require paid orders, deliveries, repeat demand and measurable industrial utilization before inferring component-scale demand.

mechanisms.label: Robotics decoupling
mechanisms.prompt_focus: Determine whether policy is creating protected Western robotics supply chains and identify suppliers benefiting specifically from lost Chinese competition.

mechanisms.label: Japan carry unwind
mechanisms.prompt_focus: Test whether rising Japanese yields plus yen strength and/or outward-flow reversal are tightening global financial conditions.

mechanisms.label: Global refinancing stress
mechanisms.prompt_focus: Distinguish bond-market volatility from actual transmission into corporate cash flow and credit quality.

mechanisms.label: Cyber to physical infrastructure
mechanisms.prompt_focus: Require confirmed operational or physical consequence. Generic cybersecurity headlines do not count.

mechanisms.label: Nuclear fuel sovereignty
mechanisms.prompt_focus: Determine whether enrichment/fuel availability rather than reactor construction is becoming the binding constraint.

mechanisms.label: Military energy autonomy
mechanisms.prompt_focus: Test whether militaries are moving from pilots toward deployable autonomous power at bases.

mechanisms.label: European strategic autonomy
mechanisms.prompt_focus: Find procurement where European governments explicitly reduce strategic dependence on non-European suppliers.

mechanisms.label: Oil-service CAPEX second wave
mechanisms.prompt_focus: Activate only when sustained high oil prices convert into producer CAPEX, drilling and completion orders. This is a lagged second-wave mechanism.
